name: Ouchi de Amaeru Shakaijin Kanojo no Ren'ai Moyou
original_name: お家で甘える社会人彼女の恋愛模様
source: A heartwarming visual novel about a romance with a younger female colleague. Enjoy an authentic office love story between two working adults navigating their careers and their feelings for each other.
translation: 一部关于与年轻女同事的浪漫故事的温馨视觉小说。享受两个职场成年人之间真实的办公室爱情故事，了解他们的职业生涯以及他们对彼此的感情。
